newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis dips, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis dips, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers were down one cent per bushel from Friday in reaction to improved flow on the river system to the U.S. Gulf, grain dealers said.

Evidence of that improved flow was the spike last week in export shipments. USDA reported soybeans inspected for export during the week ended April 24 were 18.937 million bushels versus 8.904 million the previous week.
Corn and winter wheat values were steady amid light farmer selling.
